get.description: Requires authentication. Reports readiness checks performed by the backend for its analysis runtime, database, and configured downstream services. Unconfigured services are unknown, while failed configured probes are unavailable. This is observed service health, not a frontend inference or a claim that every agent is healthy. The backend reports its runtime and database checks; an empty capabilities list means no checks were reported.

Requires authentication. Reads Yahoo Finance most-active quotes. Fresh means every returned quote has a provider timestamp no more than 24 hours old. Old or untimestamped quotes, and a last-good snapshot served after refresh failure, are marked stale. If no usable snapshot exists, the endpoint returns unavailable with an empty items list and a stable non-sensitive error_code.

Reads persisted analysis runtime history for the authenticated account only. Each item is one exact thread/run pair and can be reopened as that historical workspace snapshot. Pages use a stable descending started_at, thread_id, and run_id order; an empty account returns an empty items list and no cursor. Run timestamps and optional labels come from persisted runtime records and input data; missing values remain null.
get.summary: List the authenticated account's recent analysis runs
